description: This Java source file contains helper utility methods for managing custom datatypes in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes methods for loading datatypes and handlers, serializing configurations, converting attribute values, and saving attribute states.

classes.name: CustomDatatypeUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for working with custom data types, their handlers, serialization, validation, and attribute management within OpenMRS.

methods.name: getDatatype
methods.description: Returns a configured datatype instance based on a descriptor or class name and configuration.

methods.name: getDatatypeOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves a datatype from a descriptor or returns the default datatype if retrieval fails.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Returns a configured datatype handler based on a descriptor, class name, or defaults.

methods.name: serializeSimpleConfiguration
methods.description: Serializes a simple key-value configuration map into a string.

methods.name: deserializeSimpleConfiguration
methods.description: Deserializes a string back into a key-value configuration map.

methods.name: getValueReferences
methods.description: Converts attribute values to their reference string representations using appropriate datatypes.

methods.name: getDatatypeClassnames
methods.description: Returns a list of fully qualified class names of all registered data types.

methods.name: getHandlerClassnames
methods.description: Returns a list of fully qualified class names of all registered data type handlers.

methods.name: isCompatibleHandler
methods.description: Checks if a given handler is compatible with a specific datatype.

methods.name: saveAttributesIfNecessary
methods.description: Iterates over attributes of a customizable object and saves any that are dirty.

methods.name: saveIfDirty
methods.description: Saves the value if it has been marked as dirty, updating its reference string.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a SingleCustomValue based on its datatype configuration.
